1.c4 e5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 Nc6 4.Nc3 Bb4 5.e.strategy: Develops the knight to a square where it supports the c3 knight: if Black takes on c3, the knight recaptures and White's pawns stay intact. It also leaves the f-pawn free to advance, and prepares to challenge the centre in due course.
1.c4 e5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 Nc6 4.Nc3 Bb4 5.e.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Reversed Closed Sicilian

1.c4 e5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 Nc6 4.Nc3 Bb4 5.e.strategy: Pins the e2 knight to the queen and threatens to trade the bishop for it, removing the only white piece that covers d4. Black develops outside the pawn chain with a clear aim, while White has to unpin or accept the exchange.
1.c4 e5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 Nc6 4.Nc3 Bb4 5.e.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Reversed Closed Sicilian
